name: Claims adjuster (after-sales service)
description: Serves what the venture has already sold: knows what each customer bought, works warranty claims from receipt to close, prepares recovery from a supplier whose part failed, and checks that a service a customer is owed was delivered.

onet.title: Claims Adjusters, Examiners, and Investigators
onet.basis: The role works warranty claims from receipt to close and recovers cost from a supplier whose part failed, which is the review and settlement of claims this occupation does; matched by the process group's activities (6.3.2 and 6.3.3) against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
onet.by: agent, EE-244 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: Was this item sold by the venture, and is it still under the warranty it was sold with?
Which supplier supplied the failed part, and what does the purchase order say they owe?
